findings.title: The main description uses confusing technical jargon
findings.evidence: “Leverage our multimodal generative narrative engine to synthesise bespoke, heirloom-grade story artefacts from your household's lived-experience corpus.”
findings.why: I understand the idea from the heading and steps, but this sentence makes the service sound cold and difficult to trust rather than personal and family-friendly.

findings.title: Testimonials provide little verifiable detail
findings.evidence: “My daughter asks for ‘her’ book every single night.” — Hannah, Leeds
findings.why: The quotation sounds nice, but the location alone does not help me know whether the service is established or what the books really cost.

findings.title: Main illustration has no accessible description
findings.evidence: [image (no description) 430x440]
findings.why: If I use a screen reader, the decorative family-book image will not convey what the service is about.

findings.title: Input fields have no visible labels
findings.evidence: [5] and [6] are described as “textbox (no label)” and rely on the placeholders “Email” and “Password.”
findings.why: I can use the form now, but placeholders are less helpful with assistive technology and disappear as soon as I type.

findings.title: Footer links and copyright have very low contrast
findings.evidence: “Privacy,” “Terms,” “Contact,” and “© 2026 StoryHearth Ltd.” appear extremely faint in the footer.
findings.why: The links look difficult to read and may be hard to use for people with low vision.

findings.title: Unhelpful technical error message
findings.evidence: “Error 0x80070057: profile sync incomplete.”
findings.why: The code and wording do not explain what failed, whether it affects my book, or what I should do, so I cannot tell whether it is safe to continue.

findings.title: Error warning may undermine confidence in account data
findings.evidence: The warning appears immediately above “Welcome back, Demo,” with no reassurance about what remains usable.
findings.why: I am going to enter family memories, so an apparently incomplete profile makes me wonder whether my information will be stored or generated correctly.

findings.title: Footer text has weak visual contrast
findings.evidence: The “Privacy,” “Terms,” “Contact,” and copyright text is extremely pale grey against the white footer.
findings.why: I can barely see these links, which makes privacy and terms unnecessarily difficult to inspect.

findings.title: The form does not yet show where to enter the family memory
findings.evidence: The visible form ends after “Who else is in the story?” and the “Next” button; no memory or occasion field is visible.
findings.why: I know I need to make a book about a beach day, but this screen does not tell me whether I will be asked for that story details later.

findings.title: Relationship defaults to Grandparent without explanation
findings.evidence: [11] combobox "Relationship" shows "Grandparent" as the selected value before I choose anyone.
findings.why: It happens to be correct for Grandpa Joe, but I might not notice that the site has already selected it and could accidentally apply the wrong relationship.

findings.title: Saved character details are not confirmed
findings.evidence: The screen only shows “Your story” and three empty fields; there is no summary confirming that Sam and Grandpa Joe were retained from the previous screen.
findings.why: I can continue, but I am slightly unsure whether my earlier answers were saved.

findings.title: Footer text has very low contrast
findings.evidence: The “Privacy,” “Terms,” and “Contact” footer text is extremely faint against the white background.
findings.why: I can barely see these links when I glance at the bottom of the page.

findings.title: Reading-level choices use unexplained jargon
findings.evidence: The heading says “Reading level” and the options are labelled “Lexile BR–200L,” “Lexile 200L–500L,” “Lexile 500L–800L,” and “Lexile 800L+.”
findings.why: I know Sam is five, but these codes do not make it immediately clear which one is best for her.

findings.title: The preselected reading level is not explained
findings.evidence: “Lexile 200L–500L” is checked when the page appears.
findings.why: I cannot tell whether the site selected this because of Sam’s age or whether it is simply a default.

findings.title: Footer text has very low contrast
findings.evidence: The footer links and copyright text, including “Privacy”, “Terms”, “Contact”, and “© 2026 StoryHearth Ltd.”, are extremely faint against the background.
findings.why: I can barely read the privacy, terms, and contact information, which matters for trusting the service with a child’s photo.

findings.title: File upload control lacks a persistent associated label
findings.evidence: [30] is a “file-upload (no label)” and only shows the native “Choose file / No file chosen” control.
findings.why: The heading and instructions explain the upload, but the control itself does not visibly identify its purpose to assistive technology or a quick glance.

findings.title: Title contains a spelling error
findings.evidence: "The Magical Adventrue of Sam"
findings.why: It makes the finished book look less professional and makes me wonder whether the generated content was handled carefully.

findings.title: Selected illustration style was not applied
findings.evidence: The page says "Illustration style: Pop-art comic," but the previously selected style was "Watercolour — soft and dreamy."
findings.why: I deliberately chose watercolour, so this mismatch makes the result feel unreliable and not personalised.

findings.title: Cover does not match the submitted family memory
findings.evidence: The cover shows a generic figure, sun, star, and water, while the story details were "the beach," a "yellow bucket," and building sandcastles with Grandpa Joe.
findings.why: The cover does not include the beach activity, Grandpa Joe, or the yellow bucket, so it does not look like my family memory.

findings.title: Character details may not have been preserved
findings.evidence: The earlier profile said Sam has brown hair, and Grandpa Joe has grey hair, but the visible cover only shows Sam and gives no clear evidence of Grandpa Joe or his appearance.
findings.why: I need to know that the people in our memory are correctly represented in the book.

findings.title: Final page ends with an incomplete sentence
findings.evidence: “And from that day on, whenever Sam looked up at the sky, she would always remember”
findings.why: It makes the book look unfinished and makes me less willing to order a printed copy.

findings.title: The generated artwork does not clearly match the requested beach memory
findings.evidence: The final picture shows Sam against a simple sky-and-water background, with no visible yellow bucket, sandcastles, or Grandpa Joe.
findings.why: I expected the personal family memory to be recognisable, so this final image feels generic.

findings.title: Optional gift wrap is selected by default
findings.evidence: [6] checkbox "Premium gift wrap" (checked), adding "£7.99"
findings.why: It silently increases my total from what appears to be the necessary hardcover cost, so the real cost is not clear at first glance.

findings.title: The initial total does not plainly separate essential and optional costs
findings.evidence: "Hardcover: The Magical Adventrue of Sam £24.99", "Premium gift wrap £7.99", "Shipping & handling £12.99", "Total £45.97"
findings.why: Although I can add the numbers up, the prominent total includes an option I did not request, making the value harder to judge.

findings.title: Hardcover is misspelled in the checkout title
findings.evidence: The order summary says "Hardcover: The Magical Adventrue of Sam"
findings.why: It makes the site look unfinished and reduces my confidence that the book was prepared carefully.

findings.title: The product title is inconsistent between the preview and checkout
findings.evidence: The preview was titled "The Magical Adventrue of Sam", while checkout says "Hardcover: The Magical Adventure of Sam".
findings.why: It is unclear whether I am ordering the exact book I read or whether the title has silently changed.
